Title: Narrow Minds, Helena ADV and Telepathic Misdirection/Deflection

Messages.Author: Kilrauko
Messages.Body:
Short: While Narrow Minds is in play, Does Helena ADV pay 0 blood to play Telepathic Misdirection/Deflection?

Long: Question came up during Hämeenlinna tournament, it was ruled to cost zero as the Narrow minds cardtext is +1 cost and Helena ADV pays no costs for aus/dom reactions per cardtext and 07/07/07. However as there was no direct VDB ruling or named card rulings to reference quickly it caused a judge call, so in that sense it's a call for VDB team to include 07/07/07 ruling to Helena, Narrow minds and Dragos (and similar). Sorry, but I promised to make this post on VEKN also.

www.vekn.net/history-of-vtes-rules/450-rules-team-rulings-7-july-2007

> ...All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played ("as normal" or otherwise). All multiplication and division is handled first, followed by addition and subtraction.
> Note that pay nothing still means pay nothing, even if something else would add to the cost. So costs for cards canceled by Sudden Reversal or Direct Intervention are still not paid, for example. And Bauble and Horrid Reality still gets weapons for free. And similar for Helena and Dragos. ...
